title: Constitution of the Force.–(1) There shall be an armed force of the Union called the Sashastra
text:
4. Constitution of the Force.–(1) There shall be an armed force of the Union called the Sashastra
Seema Bal for ensuring the security of the borders of India and performing such other duties as may be
entrusted to it by the Central Government.

. Vide notification No. S.O. 3912(E), dated 30th October, 2019, this Act is made applicable to the Union territory of Jammu
and Kashmir and the Union territory of Ladakh.

-----

(2) Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Force shall be constituted in such manner as may be
prescribed and the conditions of service of the members of the Force shall be such as may be prescribed.
